summary: Tigo Energy filed an 8-K to disclose receipt of a $2,750,000 milestone payment under a previously announced patent purchase agreement with Tigo Energy Innovations LLC, bringing total cash consideration to $17,750,000 (initial $15M plus this payment). Net proceeds were ~$583,000 after expense repayment. This is a routine post-closing disclosure of contingent consideration under an asset sale that closed months earlier. No new transaction is announced; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics beyond the existing agreement. There is no risk-arb angle as this is simply a follow-up payment on a completed patent divestiture.
